claim: The incidence rate annualizes with 365.25 days/year; our deliverables use 365.
reason: A widely used adverse-event incidence rate convention annualizes with a 365-day year (cases x 365 x 1000 / person-days), and readers of those deliverables expect to see it.
suggestedCorrect: Let the analyst pick 365 or 365.25 per study; default is a choice, not a hard-code.

resolution.notes: Added spec.meta.daysPerYear (default 365.25, internally consistent; analyst may set 365). Lives in the spec so results stay reproducible. Documented in the emitter beside the constant.
